name: sstimap
summary: Automatic SSTI detection tool with interactive interface.
highlights: --module — Provide information about the module ('list' to show all modules)
--config — Use custom config file or directory
--load-urls — File or directory to load URLs from (use '-' for STDIN)
--load-forms — File or directory to load forms from (use '-' for STDIN)
--load-vuln — File or directory to load vulnerability from (use '-' for STDIN)

flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: --version
flags.description: show program's version number and exit

flags.name: --module
flags.description: Provide information about the module ('list' to show all modules)

flags.name: --config
flags.description: Use custom config file or directory

flags.name: --no-color
flags.description: Disable color in output

flags.name: --url
flags.description: Target URL (e.g. 'https://example.com/?name=test')

flags.name: --interactive
flags.description: Run SSTImap in interactive mode

flags.name: --load-urls
flags.description: File or directory to load URLs from (use '-' for STDIN)

flags.name: --load-forms
flags.description: File or directory to load forms from (use '-' for STDIN)

flags.name: --load-vuln
flags.description: File or directory to load vulnerability from (use '-' for STDIN)

flags.name: --save-vuln
flags.description: File or directory to save detected vulnerability to

flags.name: --marker
flags.description: Use string as injection marker (default '*')

flags.name: --injection-points
flags.description: Injection points to test without markers: Q(uery) B(ody) H(eaders) C(ookies). Default: QBHC

flags.name: --data
flags.description: Request body data param to send (e.g. 'param=value') [Stackable]

flags.name: --data-type
flags.description: Request body data type (default 'auto')

flags.name: --header
flags.description: Header to send (e.g. 'Header: Value') [Stackable]

flags.name: --cookie
flags.description: Cookie to send (e.g. 'Field=Value') [Stackable]

flags.name: --method
flags.description: HTTP method to use (default 'GET')

flags.name: --user-agent
flags.description: User-Agent header value to use

flags.name: --random-user-agent
flags.description: Random User-Agent header value from a list of desktop browsers on every request

flags.name: --delay
flags.description: Delay between requests (Default/0: no delay)

flags.name: --proxy
flags.description: Use a proxy to connect to the target URL

flags.name: --verify-ssl
flags.description: Verify SSL certificates (not verified by default)

flags.name: --log-response
flags.description: Include HTTP responses into ~/.sstimap/sstimap.log

flags.name: --crawl
flags.description: Depth to crawl (default/0: don't crawl)

flags.name: --forms
flags.description: Scan page(s) for forms

flags.name: --empty-forms
flags.description: Treat pages without params as GET forms

flags.name: --crawl-exclude
flags.description: RegEx in URLs to not crawl

flags.name: --crawl-domains
flags.description: Crawl other domains: Y(es) / S(ubdomains) / N(o). Default: S

flags.name: --save-urls
flags.description: File or directory to save crawled URLs to

flags.name: --save-forms
flags.description: File or directory to save crawled forms to

flags.name: --level
flags.description: Level of escaping to perform (1-5, Default: 1)

flags.name: --engine
flags.description: Comma-separated list of template engines to test: [language:[variant:]][category/]engine,... For all, use '*'

flags.name: --technique
flags.description: Techniques: R(endered) E(rror-based) B(oolean error- based blind) T(ime-based blind). Default: REBT

flags.name: --bool-ok
flags.description: RegEx to match when boolean error-based blind payload evaluates correctly

flags.name: --bool-err
flags.description: RegEx to match when boolean error-based blind payload causes an error

flags.name: --bool-match
flags.description: Comma-separated list of matching params or 'all'. Default: code,header_count,cookie_count,byte_len,body_ len,body_words,body_lines,encoding,redirects,time,url, content_type,server

flags.name: --bool-match-min
flags.description: Minimum amount of usable params for matching. Default: 7

flags.name: --blind-delay
flags.description: Delay to detect time-based blind injection (Default: 4 seconds)

flags.name: --verify-blind-delay
flags.description: Delay to verify and exploit time-based blind injection (Default: 30 seconds)

flags.name: --legacy
flags.description: Include old payloads, that no longer work with newer versions of the engines

flags.name: --generic
flags.description: Try dedicated payloads for generic engines, detecting more context.

flags.name: --run
flags.description: Run detection at the start of SSTImap in interactive mode.

flags.name: --tpl-shell
flags.description: Prompt for an interactive shell on the template engine

flags.name: --tpl-code
flags.description: Inject code in the template engine

flags.name: --eval-shell
flags.description: Prompt for an interactive shell on the template engine base language

flags.name: --eval-code
flags.description: Evaluate code in the template engine base language

flags.name: --os-shell
flags.description: Prompt for an interactive operating system shell

flags.name: --os-cmd
flags.description: Execute an operating system command

flags.name: --bind-shell
flags.description: Spawn a system shell on a TCP PORT of the target and connect to it

flags.name: --remote-shell
flags.description: Expected system shell on the target (default '/bin/sh')

flags.name: --force-overwrite
flags.description: Force file overwrite when uploading
